critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id handling was missing in officer endpoint - fixed
Type annotation for emergency contacts was too strict - fixed
WebSocket connection has expected 1-2 retry behavior before connecting (known from Phase 3)
Geolocation permission required for Encounter Mode - shows appropriate error toast when blocked
seed_data_creation: Created test user and multiple encounters during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 & 5 features fully tested and working. Encounter Mode at /encounter requires geolocation permission. Document Analysis at /analyze supports PDF, TXT, audio, video files up to 50MB. Rights Coach API provides fallback responses when AI unavailable. Similar Cases API returns landmark cases (Terry v. Ohio, Miranda v. Arizona, Graham v. Connor). Emergency contacts API works but has no UI in Settings page. All Phase 1-3 features continue to work (regression tested).
